request.text: For movie night, give me three upbeat animated films that are suitable for a ten-year-old, and remind me at 7:45 PM Shanghai time on September 1, 2026, to start the first one. No spoilers.

responsibilities.outcome: Recommend three upbeat animated films suitable for a ten-year-old without revealing spoilers.
Create a reminder for September 1, 2026 at 7:45 PM Shanghai time to start the first recommended film.

bindings.reminder_text: Start the first recommended film for movie night

new_goals.description: Recommend three upbeat, age-suitable animated films for movie night without spoilers.
new_goals.source_text: For movie night, give me three upbeat animated films that are suitable for a ten-year-old, and remind me at 7:45 PM Shanghai time on September 1, 2026, to start the first one. No spoilers.
success_criteria: The user receives three distinct animated-film suggestions that fit the requested audience and tone without plot revelations.

new_goals.description: Create a precisely timed reminder to begin the first recommended film.
new_goals.source_text: For movie night, give me three upbeat animated films that are suitable for a ten-year-old, and remind me at 7:45 PM Shanghai time on September 1, 2026, to start the first one. No spoilers.

constraints.reminder_text: Start the first recommended film for movie night

success_criteria: After required confirmation, one reminder is created for the supplied time and refers to the first recommendation.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request establishes one recommendation Goal and one separate reminder Goal.

semantic_facts: The plan must cover both ordered Goals: provide three spoiler-free, upbeat animated-film suggestions suitable for a ten-year-old and create the requested reminder with due_at 2026-09-01T19:45:00+08:00.
The reminder should refer to whichever film is presented first, so its content depends on the recommendation ordering even though its confirmation can be prepared in the same plan.
The chromie.reminder.create confirmation requirement must remain in force.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the reminder was created before confirmation and trusted execution evidence.
The response omits a Goal, reveals plot details, changes the audience or tone constraint, or silently chooses a different reminder time.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The recommendation and stateful reminder are collapsed into one Goal, causing one outcome or its constraints to disappear.
A cross-Goal reference to the first recommendation is resolved inconsistently, or the reminder is treated as completed without confirmation and evidence.
